fields.name: Capital Adequacy Ratio (CRAR)
patterns: (?:Capital Adequacy Ratio|Capital To Risk Weighted Asset(?:s)? Ratio|Capital-To-Risk-Weighted-Asset(?:s)? Ratio|Capital-Adequacy Ratio|Capital to Risk Weighted Assets Ratio \(CRAR\)|Capital to Risk Weighted Asset Ratio \(CRAR\)|Risk Weighted Asset Ratio \(CRAR\))\s*[:\-]?\s*[\.\s]*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?%?)

fields.name: Non-Performing Loan Ratio (NPL)
patterns: (?:(?<!Net\s)(?<!Gross\s)(?:Non Performing Loan Ratio|Non-performing Loan Ratio|Non-Performing Loan Ratio|Non Performing Loans?|Non-performing Loans?|Non-Performing Loans?|NPL Ratio|NPLs to total loans and advances(?:\s*\((?:percent|percentage)\))?|Percentage of Classified Loans against total loans\s*(?:and|&)\s*advances|Class\.\s*Advance/Total\s*Advance|Classified\s*Advance/Total\s*Advance|Classified\s*Advances?/Total\s*Advances?)|Gross\s+(?:NPL Ratio|Non Performing Loan Ratio|Non-performing Loan Ratio|Non-Performing Loan Ratio))\s*[:\-]?\s*[\.\s]*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?%?)

fields.name: Loan to Deposit Ratio (LDR)
patterns: (?:Loan To Deposit Ratio|Loan-To-Deposit Ratio|Advance Deposit Ratio|Advance-Deposit Ratio|Advance to Deposit Ratio|\bAD Ratio\b|\bADR\b)\s*[:\-]?\s*[\.\s]*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?%?)

fields.name: Return on Equity (ROE)
patterns: (?:Return on Equity|Return-on-Equity|Return on Shareholders'?\s*Equity|Return on Average Equity|\bROE\b|PAT\s*/\s*Average\s*Equity)\s*[:\-]?\s*[\.\s]*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?%?)

fields.name: Net Interest Margin (NIM)
patterns: (?:Net Interest Margin|Net-Interest-Margin|\bNIM\b|Net Interest Income\s*(?:as\s*)?%?\s*of\s*Working\s*Fund|Net Interest Income\s*(?:%|percent|percentage)|Net Interest Income)\s*[:\-]?\s*[\.\s]*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?%?)
